cells.reason: Multiple passages across firms and research sources directly state how service and delivery models for financial advice are shifting (multi-channel and digital delivery, AI augmentation of human advisors, fee-based/advice-led models, the independence/RIA movement, and more holistic planning).

items.text: Morgan Stanley states its multi-channel model continues to drive new assets to the platform, spanning advisor-led, workplace and self-directed channels.
items.quote: The slide illustrates our multi-channel model, which continues to drive new assets to the platform.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it is introducing new clients to the advice-based (fee-based) model while also serving clients who prefer self-directed activity through the E*TRADE franchise.
items.quote: That is happening as we do introduce new clients to the power of the advice-based model. But there are also clients who just want self-directed activity.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states that a little over 20% of all advisor-led flows are fee-based flows, showing the power of the fee-based and advice-led model.
items.quote: a little bit over 20% of all of the adviser-led flows are fee-based flows. I mean that still holds, if not growing. And so that just shows you how powerful the fee-based model and the advice-led model is.
items.unit: of adviser-led flows that are fee-based flows

items.text: Schwab states clients engage in person, on the phone, web, mobile, or via AI at different times and for different activities, and that clients value that flexibility.
items.quote: At different times in their lives and for different activities, clients engage with us in person, on the phone, web, mobile, or via AI. Our clients value that flexibility.

items.text: Schwab states more of its retail clients are seeking holistic financial advice delivered on their terms through a combination of people and increasingly AI-enabled technology.
items.quote: more of our retail clients are seeking holistic financial advice delivered seamlessly on their terms through a combination of people and increasingly AI-enabled technology.

items.text: Schwab states its wealth offer gives clients access to financial planning, full-service advice, tax, trust, and estate services, tax-aware strategies, and more, alongside banking and lending.
items.quote: With our wealth offer, clients can access financial planning, full-service advice, tax, trust, and estate services, tax-aware strategies, and more.

items.text: Raymond James states its goal is to use AI to empower advisors to provide better service, whereas many competitors use technology and AI to try to go direct to clients around their advisors.
items.quote: our goal is to use AI to better empower our advisors and financial professionals so they could provide even better service to their clients.

items.text: Raymond James states AI will not replace advisers; advisers who use AI will replace advisers who do not use AI, and that AI helps save time so advisers can deepen personal client relationships.
items.quote: We say to our advisers, AI will not replace advisers. Advisers who use AI will replace advisers who do not use AI.

items.text: Edward Jones announced a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, intending to integrate Quicken's personal financial management capabilities into Edward Jones to support advisor conversations with clients.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones as a way to support their value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.

items.text: Trade press states the independence movement has widened considerably in 2026, no longer simply a wirehouse phenomenon, with departures now coming from RIA consolidators seeking greater ownership and autonomy.
items.quote: The independence movement is no longer simply a wirehouse phenomenon. As a Dynasty Financial Partners executive noted in July 2026, the next wave of advisor departures is coming not from wirehouses but from RIA consolidators themselves

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report states that across all horizons human judgment leads while intelligence amplifies, and augmented intelligence does not replace trust or empathy but surfaces insights for relationship managers.
items.quote: one principle remains constant: human judgment leads while intelligence amplifies. Augmented intelligence does not replace trust or empathy. Instead, it identifies patterns and surfaces insights so that RMs can most effectively engage with clients.

items.text: A research source states the balance of technological enhancement with human oversight represents the future of financial advice.
items.quote: This balance of technological enhancement with human oversight represents the future of financial advice.

items.quote: the share of investors seeking more holistic advice grew from 29 percent in 2018 to 52 percent in 2023.
items.unit: share of investors seeking more holistic advice

items.text: McKinsey's survey states almost 80 percent of affluent households surveyed indicate they would rather pay a premium of 50 basis points or more for human advice than use a customized digital advice service priced at about ten basis points.
items.quote: Almost 80 percent of affluent households surveyed indicate that they would rather pay a premium of 50 basis points or more for human advice than use a customized digital advice service priced at about ten basis points
items.unit: of affluent households willing to pay a premium for human advice
